title: Align health SOP decision engine readiness
user_business_goal: Align /health subsystem readiness with the implemented SOP decision engine so operator and coordinator evidence no longer reports the SOP logic as not implemented after shadow phase logic exists.
out_of_scope: raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Domain bootstrap subsystem payload uses the same SOP decision engine state.
/health still reports status=degraded, mode=bootstrap, and decision_authority=none.
Product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model approval, camera hardware approval, and production release remain human-gated.
No production PASS/NG authority is granted.
Tests and docs reflect the readiness wording.
required_checks: HTTP preview smoke for /health when local preview is available

memory_preflight.query: FQV2 health SOP decision engine readiness after shadow SOP phase logic.
retrieved_decisions: SOP phase logic exists for shadow replay evidence but remains non-authoritative.
Product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model approval, camera hardware approval, and production release remain human gates.
retrieved_lessons: Readiness labels should distinguish implemented shadow logic from production authority.
Health evidence should not keep saying not_implemented after the app has tested shadow decision logic.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is a non-app-code auth/session blocker; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-047 PR to restore the previous health subsystem wording. Existing decision engine, replay, HMI, artifact readiness, and product CI behavior remain valid.
